title: Mass Cytometry for Multivariate Organoid Signalling Analysis
protocol: Add 127IdU directly to culture media to a final concentration of 25 μM.
Gently rotate the plate and incubate for 25 minutes at 37 ºC, 5 % CO2.
Add protease inhibitor cocktail (100⨉) and PhosSTOP (40⨉) directly to culture media.
Rotate the plate and incubate for 5 minutes at 37 ºC, 5 % CO2.
Remove culture media quickly.
Add pre-warmed 4% PFA into each well carefully.
Incubate for 60 minutes at 37 ºC, 5 % CO2.
Remove PFA solution.
Wash the cells with PBS on a rocker for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Repeat wash.
Remove PBS.
Add 0.25 μM 194/8 Cisplatin / PBS solution to each well and incubate for 10-15 minutes on a rocker at room temperature.
Remove the 194/8 Cisplatin solution.
Wash the cells with PBS on a rocker for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Repeat wash.
Reconstitute TOBis barcodes in PBS.
Add barcodes to corresponding organoid samples.
Incubate samples overnight at 4 ºC.
Remove barcoding solutions.
Wash cells with 2 mM Glutathione / CSB for 10 minutes on a rocker at room temperature.
Repeat wash twice.
Wash cells with PBS for 10 minutes on a rocker at room temperature.
Repeat wash.
Make up a dissociation solution of fresh 0.5 mg/mL Dispase II, 0.2 mg/mL Collagenase IV, and 0.2 mg/mL DNase I in PBS.
Remove PBS from the wells.
Add dissociation solution to the wells.
Scrape Matrigel droplets.
Transfer cells with dissociation solution to a gentleMACS C-tube.
Top up the dissociation solution to 5 mL per C-tube.
Dissociate organoids into single cells using a gentleMACS Octo Dissociator.
Set Heater temperature to 37 ºC.
Forward spin at 20 rpm for 2 minutes.
Backward spin at 20 rpm for 2 minutes.
Forward spin at 1500 rpm for 2 seconds.
Backward spin at 1500 rpm for 2 seconds.
Forward spin at 50 rpm for 3 minutes.
Repeat the loop of steps above 15 times.
After confirming sufficient dissociation, centrifuge C-tubes at 800 g for 1 minute to collect cells.
Transfer all cells and solution to a polypropylene FACS tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 800 g for 5 minutes and discard the supernatant.
Wash the cells with 2 mL CSB, centrifuge at 800 g for 5 minutes, and discard the supernatant. Repeat washing step.
Centrifuge the cells, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the cells in 50 μL CSB.
Prepare extracellular antibody cocktail in CSB up to a total volume of 50 μL.
Add the extracellular antibody cocktail to the cells, and incubate for 30 minutes on a rocker at room temperature. Mix cells every 10 minutes to prevent pelleting.
Add 2 mL CSB to the cells, centrifuge at 800 g for 5 minutes, and discard the supernatant.
Add 2 mL CSB to the cells, centrifuge at 800 ⨉g for 5 mins, and discard the supernatant. Repeat wash and remove the supernatant.
Place the cells on ice for 1 min.
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL of ice-cold 50% Methanol / PBS (store at -20°C until use) and incubate for 10 mins on ice.
Add 2 mL CSB to the cells, centrifuge at 800 ⨉g for 5 mins, and discard the supernatant. Repeat wash.
Resuspend the cells in 50 μL CSB.
Prepare intracellular antibody cocktail in CSB.
Add the intracellular antibody cocktail to the cells, and incubate for 30 mins on a rocker at room temperature. Mix cells every 10 mins to avoid pelleting.
Add 2 mL CSB to the cells, centrifuge at 800 ⨉g for 5 mins, and discard the supernatant.
Add 1 mL 1.6% formaldehyde (FA) / PBS solution made fresh from 16% FA to the cells.
Incubate the cells on a rocker for 10 mins at room temperature.
Add 1 mL CSB to the cells, centrifuge at 800 ⨉g for 5 mins, and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in intercalation buffer.
Gently vortex the mixture.
Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature or overnight at 4°C.
Centrifuge the cells at 800 g for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash the cells with 2 mL CSB.
Centrifuge at 800 g for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Repeat washing step.
Wash the cells with 2 mL MaxPar Water.
Centrifuge at 800 g for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of MaxPar Water.
Filter through a 35 μm cell strainer (70 μm if culture contains fibroblasts).
Count the cells.
Dilute cells to ~0.8 – 1 × 10^6 / mL in MaxPar Water.
Add EQ Beads to the cells at a volumetric ratio of 1:5.
Add EDTA to the cells to achieve a final concentration of 2 mM.
Analyse the sample on a Helios mass cytometer.
